Albuquerque’s planning agencies and civic leaders have long recognized a need to invest in public 
transportation that will drive adjustments in the region’s land use patterns in order to ameliorate traffic 
congestion, improve air quality, increase the region’s attraction to skilled professionals and innovative 
firms, increase workers’ access to jobs and residents’ access to services that can improve health and 
quality of life. Other regions around nation have invested in fixed guideway transit systems in order to 
achieve similar goals.
